rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: All four canonical F-host recovery/output receipts remain mandatory.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: Do not create a second runner/task while recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.CONTINUATION_KEY_GATE: Keep the existing continuation key unchanged.
rule_descriptions.EA_POINT_DENSITY_NOT_RESOLUTION: Point-cloud density and raster resolution are distinct concepts.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM_EDITED_SURFACE: Final edited DTM is not identical to raw ground-classified point-cloud returns.
rule_descriptions.EA_WMS_PREVIEW_NOT_SAMPLE: WMS preview is imagery and is not queryable native terrain evidence.
rule_descriptions.EA_COVERAGE_METADATA_ROLE: Coverage/index metadata is discovery/lineage evidence, not a height sample.
rule_descriptions.EA_EXACT_METADATA_FEATURE_MATCH: Survey identity requires an exact metadata-index spatial feature match.
rule_descriptions.EA_NO_DATA_NOT_ZERO: Missing coverage or survey lineage remains unknown, never numeric zero.
rule_descriptions.EA_GEOTIFF_NUMERIC_PRESERVE: Format conversion must preserve numeric values, CRS and vertical reference.
rule_descriptions.EA_TILE_PACKAGING_NOT_MEASUREMENT: 5km delivery tiling is packaging, not a measurement property.
rule_descriptions.EA_CAPTURE_PLAN_NOT_CAPTURE_PROOF: Planned capture does not prove acquisition or composite contribution.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_INDEX_MAP_DISCOVERY: Index-map results discover title numbers/registrations only.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_SIM_NOT_TITLE_EXTENT: SIM illustrative plans do not define individual title extent.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_RED_EDGING_GENERAL: Title-plan red edging indicates general extent, not exact legal line.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_OFFICIAL_COPY_NOT_EXACT: Official-copy status does not convert a general boundary to exact.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_DOCUMENT_PROVENANCE: Register/title plan/official copy provenance is distinct from terrain evidence.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_HORIZONTAL_NOT_VERTICAL: Land-registration plan uncertainty is horizontal/legal, not vertical RMSE.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM1M_PRIMARY: EA Composite DTM 1m remains the primary terrain source.
rule_descriptions.EA_DSM_EXCLUDE: DSM object-inclusive values remain excluded from bare-earth extrema.
rule_descriptions.EA_FZDSM_EXCLUDE: First-return DSM remains excluded from bare-earth extrema.
rule_descriptions.OS_SECONDARY_ONLY: OS Terrain products remain secondary plausibility/cross-check evidence.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Existing parcel numeric measurements are not changed by QA expansion.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: 96% is repository workflow confidence, not universal statistical confidence.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: No business row is promoted while recovery remains unresolved.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready remains false while required receipts are absent.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Candidate ids remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.OPERATION_SEQUENCE_GATE: Operation ids remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: Repo HTML overlay provides row visibility but is not live port-8012 acceptance.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Do not rewrite shared main manifest during concurrent slot work.
